hypothesis: Profitable pure Top Coins longs with continued price discovery can capture positive price tails after native profit taking.
scope: Only a native custom exit with exit_profit_long_tc_ prefix and >=0.5% native current profit on a pure Top Coins long with one successful entry, no previous exit and no open order. FlatProfitTail extends all; TrendProfitTail requires the last admitted hourly trade close strictly exceeds the preceding 24 closes. Select the most recent completed 1h candle as of t minus 5m, exact grid and no filled gaps. Each trade can arm once. Base engine and strategy unchanged apart from the custom-exit response on eligible lifecycles.
exit: At arm set peak to native current profit and allowable drawback to half that profit. On later callbacks update peak from native current 5m open, never highs. Honor native non-Top Coins-profit custom exits immediately. Otherwise request exit if position changes, current profit <= peak minus allowance, or 24h from arm, whichever is first. Keep release sticky if unfilled; priority native risk, then changed position, drawback, deadline. A gap or native order path may exceed the allowance. No standing protective order. Base native position adjustment, stop, ROI, regular exits and 1x leverage unchanged.
gates: Always run both strategies at both costs in the 65-day comparison. At both costs TrendProfitTail must have positive full net return above original and flat deferral, higher full return/5m drawdown than both, within +1pp 5m drawdown of original, at least 20 natural closes and 4 naturally closed deferred trades. Run 20 months only if both costs pass; additionally require above original in both calendar slices and at least 60 closes and 20 deferred natural closes. Controls in both windows were previously known.
